Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 129: December 2011
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #129 shipped to subscribers in October 2011 (bearing the cover date of December 2011 for Issue 129). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #129 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, custom downloadable content, and exclusive media previews:

Asura's Wrath (cinematic action-adventure)
The Darkness II (first-person action shooter)
UFC Undisputed 3 (mixed martial arts simulation)
Alan Wake's American Nightmare (Xbox Live Arcade action horror)
Warp (Xbox Live Arcade top-down stealth puzzle)
Choplifter HD (Xbox Live Arcade action rescue simulation)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews--featuring coverage for Mass Effect 3, Halo 4, and BioShock Infinite, alongside OXM's Game of the Year awards preview, monthly Review Roundup, and Top Plays segment.
